canonical_title: Turns and altitude loss for spin recovery

versions.title_at_revision: Turns and altitude loss for spin recovery
versions.text:
Standard: The number of turns and altitude loss for recovery for all modes of spin are no greater than the limits as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Turns and Altitude Loss for Recovery paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the number of turns and altitude loss for all modes of spin as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Turns and Altitude Loss for Recovery paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the number of turns and altitude loss for all modes of spin as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Turns and Altitude Loss for Recovery paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the number of turns and altitude loss for all modes of spin as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Turns and Altitude Loss for Recovery paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
